tagline: Global hospitality leader with industry-leading brands and a tradition of innovation
hero_kpi_rationale: Hyatt operates a diversified portfolio of 1,528 hotels and all-inclusive resorts representing 372,763 rooms as of December 31, 2025, reflecting its position as a global hospitality leader and the scope of its strategic expansion including the acquisition of Playa Hotels.

kpis.description: Total number of rooms in the hotel portfolio, including 204,841 rooms in managed hotels, 129,242 rooms in franchised hotels, and 9,190 rooms in owned and leased hotels
kpis.signal: Key indicator of hotel portfolio size and reach

risks.title: Global economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The cyclical nature of the hospitality industry exposes Hyatt to economic fluctuations, interest rates, consumer confidence and global economic growth, which directly affect travel and lodging demand.

risks.title: Intense industry competition
risks.score_rationale: Hyatt operates in a highly competitive industry with new distribution channels, alternatives to traditional hotels, and increasing consolidation among competitors.

risks.title: Natural, health and geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: Natural disasters, weather events, contagious diseases, terrorist activities and conflicts can significantly reduce lodging demand and affect operations.

risks.title: Dependence on technology and digital distribution
risks.score_rationale: Hyatt relies heavily on digital platforms, the World of Hyatt loyalty program, and third-party travel intermediaries, creating risks of technology failures and dependence on partners.

risks.title: Foreign exchange and international operations risks
risks.score_rationale: While 69.8% of revenues come from U.S. operations, 30.2% come from international operations, exposing Hyatt to foreign exchange risks, local regulations and political instability.

risks.title: Ownership structure and capital intensity risks
risks.score_rationale: The Playa Hotels acquisition increases exposure to real estate ownership, which requires significant capital and increases exposure to economic downturn risks.

risks.title: Dependence on brand trust and reputation
risks.score_rationale: Hyatt's success depends heavily on consumer trust and the reputation of its luxury-to-essential brands, with risks of reputational damage.

risks.title: Climate change risks
risks.score_rationale: Climate change can affect properties, increase operating costs, impact resource availability and reduce demand for certain destinations.

ai_positioning.summary: Hyatt recognizes AI platforms as potential new distribution channels and competitive risk, but does not implement significant AI in its current operations.
evidence: The 10-K report mentions potential AI platforms as new distribution channels that could affect consumer loyalty
Identified in risk factors as a future distribution risk
